shared_elements: large single anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
carved stone surface with incised linear detail
circular disc or roundel motif on the body
suggestion of a patterned garment or textile with banded decoration
justification: Both present a single monumental stone figure filling the field, with a headdress-like mass of hair above and a disc-shaped element at chest height amid incised garment detail. But A is a heavily eroded, frontal, three-dimensional block whose forms are barely legible, while B is a crisp, shallow profile relief with wings, beard curls and dense feather and textile patterning — utterly different in viewpoint, condition and carving technique.
